detailZones.title: Glass entry and partition
detailZones.description: Find the glass door and its handle, then follow the blinds along the windows to the left.

detailZones.title: Credenza and storage
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible credenza, cabinet doors, drawers, handles, shelves, boxes, binders and plant pot.

detailZones.title: Conference table and cable hardware
detailZones.description: Follow the cable trough across the tabletop, then look underneath for the legs, feet and modesty panel.

detailZones.title: Conference chair seating
detailZones.description: Compare the visible office chairs, backrests, seat pans, armrests, bases, columns and casters.

detailZones.title: Display and whiteboard wall
detailZones.description: Inspect the blank wall display, camera, speaker bar, whiteboard, marker tray and wall panels.

detailZones.title: Ceiling light and acoustic treatment
detailZones.description: Trace the edges of the ceiling baffles, follow the pendant cords and locate the circular diffuser.

detailZones.title: Floor and glass edges
detailZones.description: Find the access cover in the carpet and follow the glass partition to the trim along the floor.

anchorAudit.rationale: Agents reviewed all seven zones on the 1600 by 900 photograph. Each spatial term points to a visible fixture or part, including the far chair backrest, cabinet handles, floor access cover and whiteboard frame. The searchable related vocabulary includes concealed fittings and device functions that cannot be distinguished from their appearance. The user viewed the furnished room and reported no apparent issue there on 2026-11-26.
